profile.name: 标量计数通道选择组件
profile.description: 用于 EPICS SynApps 标量记录的非物理软件组件。它主要负责匹配通道名称、批量匹配名称以及选择要使用的计数通道，适合在实验采集流程中组织和定位标量计数器的通道配置。
profile.description_en: A non-physical software component for EPICS SynApps scaler records. It is mainly used to match channel names, match multiple names in batch, and select counting channels for use in experimental data-acquisition workflows.
